name: books-reader
description: Read Apple Books pages via Peekaboo + vision OCR

scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:compile && concurrently "vite" "unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && NODE_ENV=development electron dist-electron/main.js"
scripts.electron:build: npm run ui:build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder
